reels.caption:
Oliveto Vale presents a refined contemporary estate positioned on one of Bel Air's most coveted ridgelines, where sweeping canyon and city vistas meet peaceful olive trees and a sun filled architectural setting above the Bel Air Country Club.

Expansive walls of glass, clean modern design, and effortless indoor outdoor living define the residence, while multiple terraces frame treetop and skyline views designed for both entertaining and serene retreat. The primary suite offers a spa inspired bath, walk in closet, and direct access to the outdoor living spaces, complemented by a sparkling pool, lush landscaping, and view oriented lounging areas.

A masterwork by Sharon Ohana of CDH Builders with architecture and design by Mike Khalesi of Beverly Hills One, blending exclusivity, elegance, and the timeless Bel Air lifestyle.

reels.caption:
Tag someone who would love this dream closet via @msblingmiami
✨ I'm excited to offer a special virtual design consultation! The rates are $70 for one room, $135 for two rooms, $190 for three rooms, and $250 for four rooms, with an additional $50 for each extra room. If you need assistance with a combined space like a living and dining area, it's just $125.
Have multiple walls or areas that require attention? That's $80 for a 40-minute session. Typically, consultations for a foyer or bathroom are $40 each. I can also assist with new construction.
If you're looking for design guidance but prefer to shop on your own to save some money, or if you're feeling overwhelmed and unsure of how to proceed with decorating your home, I'm here to help! I'l take the time to understand you, your space, and your desired style. Together, we can arrange your current furniture, refresh your space, choose new paint colors, or tackle any area where you feel stuck.

We can connect via FaceTime or
WhatsApp, where you can show me your home. My goal is to empower you to feel confident in implementing changes independently while saving money! I'll guide you and assist you in making choices as you shop.
If you'd like me to shop for you, I charge $80 per hour. I will provide links to purchase items online from your preferred stores (Target, TJMaxx, Wayfair, Pottery Barn, etc.).
To schedule a consultation, simply send me a DM or email with your preferred days and times, as well as your time zone. Don't forget to check out my website through the link in my bio!
